Hi Mike,

No call again today, and I'm not going to dress that up. Four times now you've been told to expect one, and four times nothing. I'm sorry.

What I've done this evening is escalate it as a supervisor decision rather than another callback request, so it lands in front of Abel and Georges first thing tomorrow at 10am ET with everything attached: shipment ···· on order Shop····, tracking ····, the resealed and water-marked box, the packing paper, the Thor P2 label and your photos. That parcel left our Chattanooga warehouse and arrived with no miner in it, so this is ours to put right. There are Thor P2 units on the shelf there, so the replacement can go out as soon as it's authorised. I've also put your request to send back the three DC06 units from Shop···· on the same escalation, so both get answered together rather than one at a time.

I can't authorise the replacement or move money myself, which is the honest reason this has sat. What I can do is make sure nothing is missing when it's picked up, and it isn't. Whatever is decided comes to you in writing in this thread as well as by phone on (phone hidden).

Please hold on to the box and packaging until then.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
No worries.  I understand where i stand as a customer with your company.

Hi Mike,

That one stings, and it's fair.

You've been patient longer than anyone should have to be, and the only reason this is still open is that the decision sits with a supervisor, not with me. It's in front of them for the morning with the whole file and your number, and I'll keep it there until someone actually picks up the phone.

You'll hear it here in writing as well, so nothing depends on you catching a call at the right moment.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
